other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates aggregated statistics (group means and frequency counts) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Improper categorical encoding for tree models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses OrdinalEncoder for categorical variables and feeds them into XGBoost and CatBoost without specifying them as categorical features. This forces the models to treat arbitrary integer labels as continuous ordered features, which degrades performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal XGBoost prediction after early stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses XGBoost with early stopping but fails to specify the iteration limit during prediction. Unlike LightGBM or CatBoost, XGBoost's `predict` method defaults to using all trained trees (including those past the best iteration) unless specified, leading to suboptimal and overfitted predictions.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold CV pipeline with an optimized ensemble of LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost. However, it introduces critical data leakage by calculating group means and frequencies on the combined train-test dataset. Additionally, it mishandles categorical features in XGBoost and CatBoost by passing them as continuous ordinal values, and it fails to enforce the best iteration for XGBoost predictions.
